The '''Quelii system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A [[Unidentified Theed Palace librarian|character]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']] states that Dathomir is located in the Quelii system, but with the release of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'', the system you travel to when traveling to Dathomir is called the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]]. The game still presents these two conflicting pieces of information. It is possible the developers meant [[Quelii sector/Legends|sector]] instead of system.
